# streamsec_aws_volume_scanner_ack (Resource)

Acknowledges a Terraform install of the agentless volume scanner in one region of an AWS account, as the CloudFormation scanner stack does, so the scanner can be a hub (`streamsec_aws_scanner_hub`). Destroying it reports the scanner uninstalled. Used by the `volume-scanner` module of `terraform-streamsec-aws-account`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The volume-scanner module of terraform-streamsec-aws-account creates this once
# the scanner is installed in the region.
resource "streamsec_aws_volume_scanner_ack" "us_east_1" {
  account_id     = streamsec_aws_account.security.id
  region         = "us-east-1"
  module_version = "1.16.0"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) The Stream Security id of the AWS account (`streamsec_aws_account.<name>.id`). Changing it replaces the resource.
- `module_version` (String) The version of the Terraform module that installed the scanner.
- `region` (String) The AWS region the scanner is installed in. Changing it replaces the resource.
